<b>Threefold Pin</b> is a {{CrestSlot|Red|1}} in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. When used, [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet]] throws three pins forwards in a spreading fan pattern. Damage per pin decreases when a single enemy is hit by multiple pins at once, with each pin dealing 100%, 50%, and 33% base damage respectively.

== Usefulness ==
Similar to the [[Straight Pin]], the Threefold Pin can be thrown quickly, has a relatively high maximum capacity, and costs few [[Shell Shards]] per use, making it easy to spam without consequence. 

The Threefold Pin has higher burst and spread damage than the Straight Pin, but is less effective at range. Its reduced damage from multiple pins hitting the same enemy at once makes it most effective against crowds of enemies. However, it still does respectable damage to single targets.

== How to Acquire ==
Found in a hidden cave above [[Craw Lake]], on the eastern edge of [[Greymoor]].

==Trivia==
*The Threefold Pins were originally called Tri-Pins, and were a modified version of the Straight Pins.<ref>[https://pocketmags.com/edge-magazine/february-2021 Edge Magazine February 2021 edition], p. 57.</ref> They also had a different icon.<ref>[https://pocketmags.com/edge-magazine/february-2021 Edge Magazine February 2021 edition], p. 53.</ref>
*[[Squatcraw]]s throw their pins in a similar fashion. Additionally, before picking up the item, it looks identical to their pins.
